newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian sunseed harvest lags far behind last year.
newsitem.headline: Russian sunseed harvest lags far behind last year.

text.p: Russia's troubled sunflower seed harvest stands at 1.1 million tonnes so far, compared with 2.6 million at this time last year, State Statistics Committee figures released on Tuesday showed.
The committee said large farms, which account for about 90 percent of sunseed output, had harvested 943,000 hectares by October 7, against 1,903,000 ha at the same time in 1995.
The formerly state-run collective farms had harvested only 29 percent of land sown to sunflowers by October 7, compared with 56 percent a year earlier.
Two million hectares, or about half the area sown to sunflowers, remained to be harvested.
Independent analysts have forecast Russia's sunseed output at 3.8-4.0 million tonnes but have said that they may revise their forecasts down in coming days.
Last year's harvest was a bumper 4.2 million tonnes from a record area of 4.1 million ha.
